sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
भूय एव महाबाहो श‍ृणु मे परमं वचः ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥ १०-१॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
yatte’haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā 10-1
translation: The Blessed Lord said: Again, O mighty-armed, listen to My Supreme word; which I, wishing our welfare, will declare to you, who delight in hearing me.
